question: Where can I find attraction inside 130 kilometers while progressing from English Street Community Garden, New Haven, CT toward Montefiore Medical Center - Wakefield Campus, Bronx, NY?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%English Street Community Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New Haven%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Montefiore Medical Center - Wakefield Campus%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Bronx%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 130000 ) );
